title: Epic: cross-impl diagnosability infrastructure
description: Parent epic for structural diagnosability gaps that prevent an AI watching tests/logs from tracing packet flow and correlating failures across layers. Common format: logfmt (key=value pairs) as the universal baseline across all three implementations. JSON Lines (JSONL) as upgrade path for Python/Rust where richer structure is needed. Field naming convention defined in spec/10-implementation.md. Children cover: correlation IDs, structured logging migration (per-impl), vector test output, enum exhaustiveness, state dumps.
